source.name: Footy Headlines: Adidas Czechia 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: Adidas and the Football Association of the Czech Republic (FAČR) have officially unveiled the new Czechia 26-27 home and away kits
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as germany-2026-home, austria-2026-home). Footy Headlines' launch write-up describes the whole home shirt - classic red base, navy/white detailing on the crew-neck collar and sleeve cuffs, white three stripes across the shoulders, the Adidas performance logo and the national team crest - and nothing else on the shirt: no commercial sponsor on any placement. The Adidas kit debuted on-pitch on 2026-09-26 against Croatia, replacing the Puma 2026 home kit.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's red 26-27 home kit (the first under a new long-term FAČR deal ending Puma's 33-year run) carries only the crest, the adidas performance logo and white shoulder stripes, per Footy Headlines' launch description; debuted against Croatia on 26 September 2026.
